protocol.bridge_selection: maximize min(exact mass A, exact mass B) over the frozen rate grid; tie goes to smaller rate; require both masses >= 0.10 and exact P(B) at beta 0.75 <= half P(B) at beta one
protocol.result_rule: if at 2048 particles at least three of six independent seeds exceed the exact-posterior IID q95 for maximum three-mode error, flag mode_error_signal_requires_replication; otherwise report audit_complete_no_move_selected; neither result selects a move
protocol.interpretation: diagnostic exact calibration on a seven-detection case; not a move-selection gate; no 8192 run or untouched holdout
